title: A King Gave Away So Much Gold That Cairo's Price Fell

characters.name: Mansa Musa
characters.locked_description: Mansa Musa, a dignified West African king in his thirties, dark skin, a short neat black beard, calm watchful eyes, a tall gold-banded white turban, heavy gold earrings, layered white and indigo cotton robes

characters.name: Sultan al-Nasir
characters.locked_description: the Mamluk sultan al-Nasir, a thin man in his late thirties, a dark moustache and a heavy-lidded watchful face, a tall white turban with a gold band, a long dark blue silk robe with a wide embroidered armband

characters.name: The Mamluk emir
characters.locked_description: a Mamluk emir in his fifties, a stern lined face, a short grey beard, a high red and white turban, a long green silk robe with an embroidered sash, a curved sword at the hip

characters.name: The interpreter
characters.locked_description: a lean Arab interpreter in his forties, a trimmed black beard, an alert narrow face, a plain white turban, a long ochre robe, ink on his fingertips, a small leather satchel

characters.name: Al-Umari
characters.locked_description: a scholarly Arab historian in his forties, a round thoughtful face, a neat black beard, a white turban, a long grey-brown robe with wide sleeves, ink-stained fingers

characters.name: The Mali pilgrims
characters.locked_description: West African pilgrims of Mali, dark-skinned men in white and indigo cotton robes and wrapped turbans, some on camels and some on foot, leather water skins and long staffs

locations.name: The Cairo bazaar
locations.locked_description: a vaulted covered bazaar of Mamluk Cairo, pointed stone arches, striped awnings, hanging brass lanterns, stalls of cloth and spices and metalwork, packed beaten earth floor

locations.name: The sultan's hall
locations.locked_description: the audience hall of the Mamluk sultan in the Cairo citadel, a floor of polished marble in black and white, a high ceiling of painted wood and a carved stone throne on a low dais

key_props.name: The balance scale
key_props.locked_description: a small bronze balance with two shallow dished pans hanging on fine chains from a short crossbeam held up by a small bent bronze stand, the metal worn and darkened with age

key_props.name: The sacks of raw gold
key_props.locked_description: heavy leather sacks tied at the neck, each bulging with raw unworked gold, nuggets and gold dust spilling from the mouth of one sack, loaded in pairs on camels

key_props.name: The Catalan Atlas panel
key_props.locked_description: a panel of a medieval Catalan atlas on vellum, a crowned black king on a throne holding a gold nugget, a camel and a caravan below, bright red, blue and gold, fine ink coastlines

notes: Samostalna epizoda, ideja #35 u docs/ideas.md, prva africka na kanalu (region Africa, epoha Middle Ages, dogadjaj 1324). Mansa Musa (Mali), Kairo pod sultanom al-Nasirom. Primarni izvor je al-Umari u prevodu Levtziona i Hopkinsa (isecak, citiran u skripti doslovno); sve ostalo je Wikipedia. Narracija snimljena i poravnata (timing.json). 35 shotova (30 klipova + 5 slika), beat mapa odobrena, lockovi i storyboard upisani; vidi notes.md (osa ekrana, režim, šta ostaje). Rezim shota je mesan, birano iz kadra, ne iz kredita. Tacnost perioda: Mali iz 14. veka, sahelska odeca (pamuk, turbani, zlatni nakit), kraljevski pratioci na kamilama i konjima; Kairo 1324. je mamelucki grad: citadela, minareti, bazari, piramide u Gizi u daljini; nikakav kasniji osmanski izgled. Musa je crnoafricki kralj, dostojanstven, bez karikature i bez 'egzoticnog' kica. Scena na dvoru: sultan sedi, Musa se klanja Bogu, ne sultanu; mali covek mu sapuce. Zlato: sirovi 'nepreradjeni' komadi i prasina u vrecama, ne kovanice. Katalonski atlas c. 1375 je predmet za krupni plan (kralj sa zlatom u ruci, natpis na katalonskom); prikazati kao mapu, ne kao fotografiju. Zasto ovo nije mit: nema natprirodne razmere; ali veliki kadrovi (karavan, pustinja, grad). Ne crtati broj pratilaca iz hronika (12.000 robova, 80 kamila): to su knjizevni brojevi, skripta ih ne koristi. Dvanaest godina niske cene je al-Umarijeva tvrdnja i ne prikazuje se kao cinjenica. 'Najbogatiji covek ikad' i '400 milijardi' ne idu u naslov ni opis. Protagonists za publish.md se upisuju pre naslova: naslov ne imenuje nikog (kralj) ili imenuje sve glavne (Mansa Musa, al-Nasir), nikad jednog + deo.
